faq.title: Curing, care, warranty, and booking policy.

items.q: How long does window tint take to cure?
items.a: Film typically cures within 3 to 5 days in warm Texas sun, or up to 2 weeks in cooler weather. Keep windows rolled up for at least 72 hours after installation.

items.q: Are small hazy spots or moisture pockets normal right after installation?
items.a: Yes. Residual mounting solution evaporates naturally through the film over the first few days, leaving an optically clear finish.

items.q: How should I clean tinted windows?
items.a: Use an ammonia-free glass cleaner and a clean microfiber towel. Avoid abrasive pads or ammonia-based sprays.

items.q: What does the lifetime warranty cover?
items.a: Every tier covers bubbling, peeling, cracking, and color fade for as long as you own the vehicle. Higher ceramic tiers include transferable coverage.

items.q: What is your deposit and cancellation policy?
items.a: Your $50 deposit reserves your studio bay and goes directly toward your total. Cancellations made at least 24 hours before your appointment are refunded automatically.
